correctness.rationale: The cone vertex blowup is Tot(O_S(-1)), with one exceptional divisor of order 1, Nash factorization by the homogeneous tangent Gauss map and Mather Jacobian order 2, so Ratajczak Theorem 1.2 gives Θ=[S]/[P²]. Equality yields [S]=[T] in the stated localization; finite-weight Tate-shift cancellation in K0(MHS_Q) and semisimplicity imply H² Hodge isomorphism, hence equal Picard number. Rational-marking orbits are countable and K3 local Torelli makes period fibers discrete, giving countable density fibers. Smooth quartic parameter space connected; Ehresmann carries the link circle bundle through the deformation, giving homeomorphic cone germs.

value.rationale: The motivating invariant was designed to refine classical local multiplicity. Showing uncountably many distinct values for homeomorphic, multiplicity-four isolated threefold hypersurface germs is a global structural sharp contrast with classical/topological invariants. The theorem provides a natural Hodge-theoretic explanation and a rank-20 versus rank-1 witness, rather than an arbitrary small computation.
